t: 巴格达之围以最后的阿拔斯哈里发向蒙古帝国王子胡莱古汗投降而告终.
te: The Siege of Baghdad ends with the surrender of the last Abbasid caliph to Hulegu Khan, a prince of the Mongol Empire.
dz: 巴格达之围以最后的阿拔斯哈里发向蒙古帝国王子胡莱古汗投降而告终.
de: The Siege of Baghdad ends with the surrender of the last Abbasid caliph to Hulegu Khan, a prince of the Mongol Empire.

t: 蒙古帝国的王子胡莱古·可汗命令他的军队将刚被他们俘虏的巴格达城洗劫一空并掠夺.
te: Hulegu Khan, a prince of the Mongol Empire, orders his army to sack and plunder the city of Baghdad, which they had jus…
dz: 围攻巴格达:蒙古帝国的王子胡莱古·可汗命令他的军队将刚被他们俘虏的巴格达城洗劫一空并掠夺.
de: Siege of Baghdad: Hulegu Khan, a prince of the Mongol Empire, orders his army to sack and plunder the city of Baghdad, which they had just captured.

t: 法国的路易九世和阿拉贡的詹姆斯一世签署"科比尔条约",放弃了对方领地上封建霸权的主张,将巴塞罗…
te: Louis IX of France and James I of Aragon sign the Treaty of Corbeil, renouncing claims of feudal overlordship in one an…
dz: 法国的路易九世和阿拉贡的詹姆斯一世签署"科比尔条约",放弃了对方领地上封建霸权的主张,将巴塞罗那宫与法国政治隔开.
de: Louis IX of France and James I of Aragon sign the Treaty of Corbeil, renouncing claims of feudal overlordship in one another's territories and separating the House of Barcelona from the politics of France.

t: 在阿克里战役中,威尼斯人击败了一支规模更大的热那亚分舰队出海去解除阿克里.
te: In the Battle of Acre, the Venetians defeat a larger Genoese fleet sailing to relieve Acre.
dz: 圣萨巴斯之战: 在阿克里战役中,威尼斯人击败了一支规模更大的热那亚分舰队出海去解除阿克里.
de: War of Saint Sabas: In the Battle of Acre, the Venetians defeat a larger Genoese fleet sailing to relieve Acre.

t: 弗雷德里克二世的私生子曼弗雷德被加冕为西西里国王.
te: Manfred, illegitimate son of Frederick II, is crowned king of Sicily.
dz: 弗雷德里克二世的私生子曼弗雷德被加冕为西西里国王.
de: Manfred, illegitimate son of Frederick II, is crowned king of Sicily.

te: Regent George Mouzalon and his brothers are killed during a coup headed by the aristocratic faction under Michael VIII …
dz: 摄政乔治·穆扎隆和他的兄弟在迈克尔八世·帕莱奥洛戈斯领导下的贵族派系所领导的政变中被杀死,为它的领袖最终篡夺尼卡埃亚帝国的王位铺平了道路.
de: Regent George Mouzalon and his brothers are killed during a coup headed by the aristocratic faction under Michael VIII Palaiologos, paving the way for its leader to ultimately usurp the throne of the Empire of Nicaea.
